launcher_source:
# Exactly one coordinator-authorized cohort. This caller does not change the
# frozen harness, workers, estimator, heap floors, order, or counter seams.
require "json"
require "fileutils"
require "digest"

ROOT = "/home/user/workspace/lowrail"
HARNESS = "/home/user/workspace/lowrail-block-link-harness"
PIN = "da5fe91e2f04a27acef1f7245efa7f39a7332577"
APP = File.join(ROOT, ".corpus/fizzy-link")
OUT = File.join(ROOT, ".lowrail/private/fizzy-block-link-ir-20261021")
TOOL = File.join(ROOT, ".lowrail/private/valgrind-3.19-brk512")
require File.join(HARNESS, "bench/request_pairs")
require File.join(HARNESS, "bench/experiments/fizzy_link_vector")

raise "cohort directory already exists; never retry" if File.exist?(OUT)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(OUT, mode: 0o700)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.join(OUT, "states"), mode: 0o700)
gate_report = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(ROOT, "docs/fizzy-link-gates.json")))
expected = gate_report.fetch("warm_completed_hits_per_site")
raise "preregistered mix changed" unless expected.size == 23 && expected.values.sum == 24 && expected.values.count(&:positive?) == 19 && expected.values.count(&:zero?) == 4
raise "wrong approved gate pin" unless gate_report.dig("pins", "harness_sha") == PIN
expected_path = File.join(OUT, "expected-warm-hits.json")
File.write(expected_path, JSON.pretty_generate(expected) + "\n")
contexts = File.join(ROOT, ".lowrail/private/fizzy-link-contexts-v10.json")
artifact = File.join(ROOT, ".lowrail/private/fizzy-link-delivery-v6")
seed = File.join(ROOT, ".lowrail/private/fizzy-link-gates-seed")
preflight = File.join(OUT, "preflight-state")
FileUtils.cp_r(seed, preflight)
env = FizzyLinkFixture.environment(APP, preflight).merge(
  "BENCH_HARNESS_SHA" => PIN, "BENCH_BLOCK_LINK_COHORT_APPROVED" => PIN,
  "BENCH_FIZZY_APP" => APP, "BENCH_FIZZY_ARTIFACT" => artifact,
  "BENCH_FIZZY_CONTEXTS" => contexts, "BENCH_FIZZY_WARM_HITS" => expected_path,
  "BENCH_STATE_ROOT" => File.join(OUT, "states"), "BENCH_STATE_SEED" => seed,
  "BENCH_JIT" => "0", "BENCH_JOBS" => "1", "BENCH_AA_TOLERANCE" => "0.5",
  "BENCH_WORKDIR" => APP)
env.each { |key, value| value ? ENV[key] = value : ENV.delete(key) }
pin = FizzyLinkVector.pin!(app: APP, artifact: artifact, contexts: JSON.parse(File.read(contexts)))
raise "gate inputs changed" unless pin.reject { |key, _| key == "entropy_policy_sha256" } == gate_report.fetch("pins").reject { |key, _| key == "entropy_policy_sha256" }
raise "fixture changed" unless gate_report.fetch("fixture_seed_sha256").all? { |file, sha| Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(seed, file)).hexdigest == sha }
rule = {
  "authorization" => "coordinator T-01a155f6-872d-7318-81bf-9be64530289e: exactly ONE interpreter-Ir cohort; one slot; no retry/exclusions/YJIT",
  "harness_sha" => PIN, "launcher_sha256" => Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,
  "rounds" => 6, "seed" => 41231, "N" => [0, 50], "arms" => %w[off_a off_b on], "jobs" => 1,
  "decision_rule" => "INVALID on any exact per-site hit mix, pin, mode, heap or brk violation; accept a controlled warm price only if both total and GC-excluded A/A 95% CIs contain zero and lie within ±0.5%. Any failed A/A rejects the entire cohort. Report whichever result occurs; no retry or exclusions.",
  "scope" => "warm bench price for six Fizzy GETs only, not production admission or cold-start cost; first-original acquisition/setup outside warm windows; every per-hit guard/observation/dependency/count inside",
  "cold_status" => "RED/rejected_off_control",
  "named_off_off_rejections" => gate_report.fetch("named_off_off_rejections"),
  "uncovered" => ["payload/assigns", "lazy cached-bind values", "SolidCache completion"],
  "expected_hits_per_iteration" => expected, "expected_N50_hits" => 1200,
  "gate_report_sha256" => Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(ROOT, "docs/fizzy-link-gates.json")).hexdigest,
  "pins" => pin, "fixture_seed_sha256" => gate_report.fetch("fixture_seed_sha256"),
  "valgrind" => JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(TOOL, "share/lowrail/valgrind.json")))
}
File.write(File.join(OUT, "preregistered.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(rule) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(event: "decision_rule_before_numbers", rule: rule.fetch("decision_rule"))
$stdout.flush
environments = %w[off_a off_b on].to_h { |arm| [arm, env.merge("BENCH_FIZZY_ARM" => arm == "on" ? "on" : "off")] }
metadata = {rounds: 6, seed: 41231, workers: {}, harness_sha: PIN,
  scenario: "VECTOR:fizzy-links", preregistered_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(OUT, "preregistered.json")).hexdigest}
begin
  accepted = RequestPairs.heap_instructions(environments, APP, OUT, "VECTOR:fizzy-links", metadata,
    worker: File.join(HARNESS, "bench/experiments/fizzy_link_vector.rb"), requests: 50)
  workers = metadata.fetch(:workers)
  mix = workers.size == 18 && workers.all? do |name, worker|
    worker.dig("pins", "harness_sha") == PIN && worker.fetch("vector_ledgers").size == 4 &&
      worker.fetch("vector_ledgers").all? do |ledger|
        n = ledger.fetch("vectors")
        [0, 50].include?(n) && ledger.fetch("completed_hits") == expected.transform_values { name.end_with?("-on") ? _1 * n : 0 }
      end
  end
  raise "INVALID: preregistered per-site mix/pin differs" unless mix
  summary = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(OUT, "summary.json")))
  raise "INVALID: heap/mode gate failed" unless summary.fetch("heap_matched") && summary.fetch("jit").fetch("pass")
  File.write(File.join(OUT, "decision.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(status: accepted ? "accepted_scoped_warm_price" : "rejected_controls",
    mix: mix, workers: workers.size, retry: false, exclusions: [], cold_status: "RED/rejected_off_control") + "\n")
rescue Exception => error
  File.write(File.join(OUT, "decision.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(status: "INVALID", error: error.class.name,
    reason: error.message, completed_workers: metadata.fetch(:workers).size, retry: false, exclusions: [], cold_status: "RED/rejected_off_control") + "\n")
  raise
end
